benchmark.schemaSql: CREATE TABLE products (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE order_items (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, product_id INTEGER NOT NULL, quantity INTEGER NOT NULL); CREATE INDEX idx_order_items_product_id ON order_items(product_id);

title: [パフォーマンスチューニング][確認しよう] JOIN前に集計して行数を減らす
statement:
products と order_items から、商品ごとの売上数量を表示してください。表示する列は product_name, sold_quantity。売上がない商品は 0 とし、sold_quantity の降順、product_name の昇順で並べます。

order_items を product_id ごとに集計してから products と結合します。

constraints.name: 事前集計
constraints.value: order_items を product_id ごとに集計してから products とJOINします

constraints.name: 売上なし
constraints.value: 売上がない商品も0として表示します

starterSql:
WITH item_totals AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    SUM(quantity) AS sold_quantity
  FROM order_items
  GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT
  products.name AS product_name,
  COALESCE(item_totals.sold_quantity, 0) AS sold_quantity
FROM products
LEFT JOIN item_totals
  ON item_totals.product_id = products.id
ORDER BY sold_quantity DESC, products.name ASC;
solutionSql:
WITH item_totals AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    SUM(quantity) AS sold_quantity
  FROM order_items
  GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT
  products.name AS product_name,
  COALESCE(item_totals.sold_quantity, 0) AS sold_quantity
FROM products
LEFT JOIN item_totals
  ON item_totals.product_id = products.id
ORDER BY sold_quantity DESC, products.name ASC;
